SSMC ONE-STOP BREAST ASSESSMENT CLINIC - ABU DHABI
Attendance: Attended recall clinic on schedule.
Reason for Recall: Right UOQ focal asymmetry on screening mammogram (BI-RADS 0).
Assessment Performed: Clinical breast examination (normal, P1), right spot compression craniocaudal and MLO views, and targeted high-frequency right breast ultrasound.
Findings: The focal asymmetry disperses completely on spot compression, representing summation of normal fibroglandular tissue. Ultrasound of the right UOQ shows normal breast parenchyma with no solid or cystic mass. No biopsy required.
Outcome / Decision: Discharged back to routine biennial screening (Return to Routine Screening).

CLEVELAND CLINIC ABU DHABI - DIAGNOSTIC BREAST ASSESSMENT REPORT
Patient Status: Attended appointment.
Indication: Recall from screening for a 10 mm circumscribed mass in the left breast.
Diagnostic Workup: Targeted left breast ultrasound performed.
Findings: At the 3 o'clock position, 4 cm from the nipple, corresponding to the mammographic density, there is a classic anechoic simple cyst measuring 10 x 7 mm with imperceptible walls and posterior acoustic enhancement (BI-RADS 2). No needle aspiration or core biopsy indicated.
Disposition: Benign finding. Return to routine 2-year screening mammography.

عيادة تقييم الثدي التخصصية - مستشفى توام (TAWAM BREAST ASSESSMENT UNIT)

Reason for Recall: Left retroareolar questionable microcalcifications.
Assessment: True lateral and magnification views of the left breast (الثدي الأيسر) plus targeted ultrasound.
Findings: Magnification views demonstrate classic tea-cup (milk of calcium) layering within microcysts on the 90-degree lateral projection. Ultrasound confirms tiny clustered microcysts. Benign BI-RADS 2; no biopsy performed.
Decision (القرار الطبي): Return to routine screening (العودة للفحص الدوري الروتيني كل سنتين).

SKMC DIAGNOSTIC BREAST CLINIC - ABU DHABI
Attendance: Attended.
Clinical & Past History: Note that in 2021 she underwent an ultrasound-guided core biopsy of the right breast which showed benign sclerosing adenosis (B2), and her mother was treated for breast cancer in 2017.
Today's Recall Assessment: Recalled for a new density in the left upper inner quadrant. Spot compression tomosynthesis and targeted left breast ultrasound were performed today.
Findings: The left UIQ density corresponds to a typical 6 mm reniform intramammary lymph node with a preserved echogenic hilum. No biopsy was performed during this episode.
Outcome: Reassured and discharged to routine biennial screening.

All imaging confirmed normal overlapping fibroglandular stroma with no discrete mass lesion and no microcalcifications. No biopsy was needed.
She has been returned to the routine 24-month screening programme.

SSMC MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM (MDT) BREAST MEETING MINUTES
Patient Attendance at Assessment: Attended Triple Assessment on 12/10/2026.
Assessment Summary: Recalled for 14 mm lobulated right breast mass at 9 o'clock. Ultrasound-guided 14G core needle biopsy performed.
Histopathology Result (This Episode): Three cores of breast tissue showing a benign fibroadenoma with pericanalicular growth pattern; no atypia, no in-situ or invasive malignancy (B2 benign, concordant with imaging).
MDT Outcome: Concordant benign biopsy. Discharge patient back to routine biennial screening.

TAWAM HOSPITAL BREAST MDT RECORD - AL AIN
Episode Attendance: Attended diagnostic assessment and stereotactic biopsy.
Imaging: Recalled for a 9 mm cluster of amorphous microcalcifications in the left upper outer quadrant (scored M4a).
Pathology (Left 9G Vacuum-Assisted Core Biopsy): Sections show florid sclerosing adenosis and apocrine metaplasia with abundant luminal microcalcifications; immunohistochemistry confirms intact p63/calponin myoepithelial cell layer throughout. Whilst sclerosing adenosis can radiologically and histologically mimic invasive carcinoma, there is no atypia, no DCIS, and no malignancy (B2 Benign).
MDT Decision: Radiology-pathology concordance confirmed. Return to routine screening.

CCAD BREAST ASSESSMENT & PATHOLOGY ADDENDUM
Attendance: Attended diagnostic clinic.
Workup Done: Diagnostic mammography, ultrasound, and ultrasound-guided core biopsy of a 12 mm irregular hypoechoic area in the right lower outer quadrant (history of seat-belt trauma 4 months ago).
Biopsy Result: Benign fat necrosis with lipid-laden macrophages, foreign-body giant cells, and haemosiderin; negative for atypia or malignancy.
Final Outcome: Benign concordant result. Return to routine screening.

BURJEEL MEDICAL CITY - BREAST MDT SUMMARY

Current Recall Episode: Attended assessment for a new 8 mm cluster of microcalcifications in the left central breast. Stereotactic core biopsy performed during this episode yielded representative calcifications on specimen radiograph.
Histopathology (Current Episode): Benign fibrocystic change with microcysts, stromal fibrosis, and calcium oxalate crystals (B2 Benign).
MDT Outcome: Return to routine two-yearly screening.

SSMC BREAST MDT OUTCOME SHEET
Attendance: Attended assessment unit.
Workup: Recalled for architectural distortion in the right upper outer quadrant. Tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted excision biopsy (VAE, 7G) performed.
Pathology (This Episode): Completely excised 6 mm radial scar (benign complex sclerosing lesion) with fibroelastotic core; although radial scars mimic spiculated carcinoma on mammography, comprehensive sampling shows no epithelial atypia, no LCIS/DCIS, and no invasive malignancy (B2/B3 fully excised benign lesion).
MDT Decision: No surgery required; return to routine screening.

TAWAM HOSPITAL BREAST ASSESSMENT CLINIC - AL AIN

Outcome: Early recall at 6 months for unilateral right magnification mammography.

SSMC MULTIDISCIPLINARY BREAST ONCOLOGY BOARD - ABU DHABI
Attendance: Attended One-Stop Triple Assessment Clinic.
Assessment Performed: Bilateral diagnostic mammography, bilateral breast and axillary ultrasound, and ultrasound-guided 14G core biopsies of the right UOQ 18 mm spiculated mass and a cortical-thickened right axillary node.
Biopsy Result (This Episode): Right breast core biopsy = Invasive ductal carcinoma (NST), Grade 2, ER positive (Allred 8/8), PR positive (7/8), HER2 negative (IHC 1+), Ki-67 18% (B5b Malignant). Right axillary node = metastatic carcinoma.
MDT Outcome: Referred to breast surgical oncology for right wide local excision and axillary clearance (To Treatment).
